title: Rae P NDE 3500
content: After knee surgery in Mackay Base Hospital. I had begun hemorrhaging after surgery and they could not be stopped. Medical staff had told my family they could do no more. I remember light and waking up later telling the nurses I was in pain. She asked why I had not told the doctor. I have no memory of the doctor being there. (This was very early morning hours.) After this, I have no fear of dying or, indeed of any medical emergency. I had a similar experience on October 4 1971 when giving birth to my second child. I hemorrhaged heavily about two hours after for several hours and nurses called my husband back to the hospital and told him there was no more they could do. Once again, it stopped as quickly as it started, and I was quite at ease. I have had a severe car accident (five wedge compression fractures of the spine and a fractured sternum) but had no thought of death or even worry over the possible outcome.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No Surgery-relatedChildbirth Other In both cases clinical staff told me they did not know why or how I survived as they had done everything possible with no result.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal After leaving body to enter light.
elements.At what time during the experience were: After leaving body to enter light.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Like space and time stood still - did not exist.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes The whole experience happened in a 'cavern'.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes Only because others didn't understand.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Fairly soon. Within six months. With my husband. He accepted what I had experienced without really understanding.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real Did not think about it until a couple months later when my doctor said they had given up on me and didn't know what was happening.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I find I now feel quite comfortable with my life and am content there is an overall plan for me.
